summary: Two Mexico City tourists hiking Mt. Sanitas west of Boulder were unprepared for how quickly it got dark and got lost; BCSO, Rocky Mountain Rescue, Boulder Rural Fire and Boulder Mountain Fire responded to a 911 call ~8:10 p.m.; they were found near the summit and led to safety without further incident
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office (with Rocky Mountain Rescue Group)
